Description: The number of binding events in the pick that have a measured dark time (the first event of a pick has none).
The number of localizations in the pick (before linking).
Mean and standard deviation of a column of the linked localizations (see Table 1) over the binding events of the pick, e.g., x_mean or photons_std.
Mean bright and dark times, averaged over the binding events. Units: frames.
Mean bright and dark times estimated by fitting their distributions with the CDF of the exponential distribution. Units: frames.
The qPAINT index, i.e., the inverse of dark_mean and dark_cdf, respectively. Units: 1/frames.
The number of binding sites from qPAINT: 1 / (influx rate × dark_cdf). The influx rate is stored in the metadata.
The area of the pick in µm² (only when saved from picks).
